name: search
description: Comic Vine — search the comic-book reference database (characters, issues, volumes, publishers, creators, story arcs) by name. Resource list: character, concept, issue, location, object, person, publisher, story_arc, team, volume. Use ONLY for fictional comic-book entities — Marvel, DC, indie comics, manga. NOT for machine learning / ML / AI research (use arxiv_search_papers) or real-world events.

name: characters
description: Browse Comic Vine's fictional character directory. Filter by name, publisher, or first-appearance date (filter="name:Spider-Man"); paginate with limit/offset. Returns character IDs, names, publishers, and deck summaries.

name: character
description: Comic Vine single character detail by ID: real name, aliases, powers, first appearance, publisher, team affiliations. Fictional comic-book characters only.

name: issues
description: Comic Vine list of single comic-book issues (one printed magazine). Filter by volume, store-date, name. For magazine-level comic data.

name: issue
description: Comic Vine single comic-book issue detail by ID: cover date, store date, issue number, volume, story arcs, characters featured.

name: volumes
description: Comic Vine list of comic-book series/volumes (a "volume" = ongoing series like "Amazing Spider-Man Vol. 5"). Filter by name, publisher.

name: volume
description: Comic Vine single series/volume detail: name, start year, publisher, issue count, deck description.

name: people
description: Browse Comic Vine's comic-book creator directory (writers, artists, inkers, letterers, colorists). Filter by name; paginate with limit/offset. NOT a general biography search — for actors use TMDb, for general bios use Wikipedia.

name: person
description: Comic Vine single creator detail: name, country, birth/death, deck. Comic-book creator only.

name: publishers
description: Browse the Comic Vine publisher list (Marvel, DC, Image, Dark Horse, etc.). Filter by name; paginate with limit/offset. Returns publisher IDs and names useful for filtering characters, volumes, and issues by publisher.
